sloka: यदि शूर्पणखा हेतोः जनस्थान गत खरः ।अति वृत्तो हतः पूर्वम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा ।अत्र ब्रूहि यथावत् त्वम् को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः ॥३-३९-२४॥
transliteration: yadi śūrpaṇakhā hetoḥ janasthāna gata kharaḥ ।ati vṛtto hataḥ pūrvam rāmeṇa akliṣṭa karmaṇā ।atra brūhi yathāvat tvam ko rāmasya vyatikramaḥ ॥3-39-24॥

translations.english: For the sake of Surpanakha, Khara of Janasthana committed excesses and got killed by Rama who can accomplish things with ease.Tell me truly if Rama did violate anything here.
